scope: Designer workflow, visual refresh, capture/editability reliability and prototype review

changes.startup: Projects open directly with an inline four-step path; the former blocking four-page tour is now concise optional help.
changes.visualDesign: Neutral light and dark surfaces, compact typography, consistent modern inputs and focus states, quieter borders, reduced shadows and decoration, compact source choices, contextual labels and less empty-state duplication. Starting from a known captured page skips disabled source choices entirely.
changes.projectJourney: Inline Repository → Connect app → Capture pages → Design & prototype navigation with working actions and persisted connection state.
changes.connections: Pages accepts localhost and verified HTTPS hosts. Domain verification can be downloaded and completed from Pages, setup or capture. Source/URL fields retain full widths. Newer typed addresses are preserved when a previous verification finishes.
changes.editableCapture: Captured native screens retain their structured trees, independent element IDs and fonts when creating a design or adding them from the library. New designs retain project component context and app URL.
changes.inspector: Native captured layers now expose font, weight, alignment, spacing, colour, opacity, corner radius, border, shadow, rotation and visibility, alongside position/size and inline text editing.
changes.prototypes: Friendly action names, a shared accessible import-confirmation modal, stable draft revisions and existing explicit approval workflow.
changes.robustness: Modal-aware keyboard/menu commands, nested dialog handling, input hints and errors associated with their controls, project-load race guards, sensible recovery when Claude Code is no longer installed.
performance: Graph, prototype runner and draft review load on demand.
The 184.52 KB graph module is absent at startup; actual Chromium script-loading events confirm it loads on Flow entry.
Capture lists index screens by route/session instead of repeated full scans.
Flow metadata edits preserve existing page references and memoized thumbnails.
Prototype hotspot/state DOM work no longer reruns for every form keystroke.
Consecutive manual draft edits coalesce into one manual version instead of appending a full document for every edit.

verification.designerJourney: passed: startup, optional guidance, setup, file download and host verification, local capture, editable design creation, native property editing and hide/show, flow, preview, themes and compact dialog containment
verification.hostVerificationTestScope: The real verification download/save/verify IPC is exercised against fixture tokens. Remote verification responses and remote reachability are deterministic test transports; no claim is made of deploying a verification file to a public website.
verification.prototype: passed: isolated generation, real form input, back/state, revisions, coalesced manual versions, restart/recovery, approval, disk-write failure rollback/retry, undo/redo, manual connections, shared screens and 20-screen flow
verification.capture: passed: direct and multi-size batch capture, dynamic routes, failure isolation, sign-in/resume, editable persistence; interactive capture and inline text editing
verification.projectHub: passed: saved projects, filtering/sort, grid/list, missing folder recovery, setup cancellation and compact help
verification.modalSystem: passed: focus trap/restoration, Escape, backdrop policies, validation, themes and small-window containment
verification.claudeCode: passed: login, models, references, subprocess/tool boundary, cancellation/failure, credential isolation and disconnect without logout
verification.anthropicApi: passed: tool loop, source proposals, apply/undo, component reuse, approved commands and runtime comparison
verification.canvas: passed: presets, grids, drawing, styling, commands, components, offline prototypes, resizing and persistence
verification.packagedApp: passed: mounted checksum-verified DMG; complete designer journey, lazy graph loading, AI prototype/import/restart/rollback, modal keyboard behaviour and fresh build-specific profile
verification.targetedLint: passed: shared modal, startup guidance, new-design form, native inspector, runtime settings, lazy workspaces and address validation

limits: Prototype interactions simulate local behaviour; they do not execute a real application backend.
Arbitrary source-component state machines, custom animations and partial draft approval remain outside the implemented prototype runtime.
The review package targets macOS x64 and uses the existing unsigned local-review configuration.
